summary: Entity 510 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods before the first cut.
